items.text: Giants WR Malik Nabers (knee) is active for SNF vs Cowboys; earlier murky/up-to-him, PS elevations noted. Berry starting everywhere despite decoy risk.
items.why: Knee, full practice but final call his; elevated Berrios/Cambre as contingency
items.implication: Start with high upside; monitor snap share

items.text: Cardinals RB Jeremiyah Love (ankle) is ACTIVE; risk/reward RB2 but start everywhere as they wouldn't activate if worried. Confirmed expected to play earlier.
items.why: Ankle sprain, expected and activated; full or limited but cleared
items.implication: Start as RB2 with upside in Cardinals backfield

items.text: Bears WR Rome Odunze (calf) officially active vs Panthers after expected to play reports.
items.why: Calf injury, looked good, self-reported ready
items.implication: Start with volume in Bears offense alongside Burden etc.

items.text: Weekend reports summary: Love and Odunze expected to play; Kamara not expected; Josh Williams activated (Tucker doubtful); Nabers no news yet (later active). Kamara status impacts Etienne projections.
items.implication: Update lineups for early window; Etienne boost

items.text: Saints RB Alvin Kamara (knee/MCL sprain) is not expected to play and officially inactive vs Lions; full participant late week but not ready. Beneficiaries include Travis Etienne as lead back.
items.why: MCL sprain, progressed but game plan set, wait for Week 2
items.implication: Etienne unchallenged lead; Kendre Miller RB2

items.text: Starting Malik Nabers everywhere; risk/reward as possible decoy but active for SNF.
items.why: Active, elite talent, volume expected if healthy

items.text: Ravens rookie WR Ja'Kobi Lane ruled OUT due to wrist injury.
Jeremiyah Love ACTIVE: risk/reward RB2 but starting him everywhere; wouldn't activate if injury concern (though Cardinals caveat).
items.why: Active confirmation + preseason belief in role
items.implication: Start over safer options for upside

items.text: Raiders TE Brock Bowers OUT after meniscus trim procedure; realistic chance return Week 2 vs Chargers (miss 1-2 games). Mayer elevated role.
items.why: Meniscus trim on knee from camp injury
items.opportunity: Michael Mayer TE1 targets/snaps this week

items.text: Patriots WR AJ Brown high ankle sprain, no surgery needed, sidelined 4-6 weeks.
items.why: High ankle sprain, conservative no-surgery approach
items.implication: Long-term sit; WR depth chart shifts in NE

items.text: Main slate news locked; only major proj change possible is Nabers (Q knee) for SNF—situation murky/up to him. Giants elevated Berrios and Cambre. Projections updating live, no other major changes.
items.why: Knee, personal decision; PS call-ups signal caution
items.implication: Hold for final inactive; adjust ownership/projs if out

items.text: Josh Williams activated from PS; Sean Tucker doubtful (later inactive). Impacts TB backfield with Irving/Gainwell.
Buy low on Colston Loveland; preseason wanted Bears offense share, Week 1 weirdness (Kmet/Raymond) doesn't change long-term view.
items.why: Preseason hype + Bears offense belief; short-term target competition
items.opportunity: TE routes/targets in evolving Bears attack

items.text: Dontayvion Wicks more real than not; preseason talked heavily re Packers to new OC Sean Mannion move.
Steelers CB Joey Porter Jr. officially inactive (back + contract murky/trade possible).
Not expecting major projection changes beyond Nabers news; full player projs available and updating.
items.implication: Trust current ETR numbers for lock

items.text: Chuba Hubbard flex play this week, viable; keeping open on him.
Thorman snaps & pace: NO @ DET up in pace; MIA @ LV slow slog. Full Week 1 available.
items.implication: Higher volume for NO-DET players; lower for MIA-LV
